description: Disk writes of an algod node attributed to each writer: the SQLite stores, node.log, the agreement snapshot and the block database content. Metrics are documented in docs/disk_io_metrics.md of go-algorand.

panels.title: Round time
panels.description: Seconds per round, from algod_ledger_round.

panels.title: Stores, per round
panels.description: Bytes written on behalf of the selected stores per round over the dashboard range: write-ahead log frames, plus the checkpoint copying them into the database file, plus zero pages of EraseWAL.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (sum by (instance, db) (increase(algod_db_wal_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$__range]) + increase(algod_db_backfill_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$__range]) + increase(algod_db_wal_erase_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$__range]))) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (delta(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.title: node.log, per round
panels.description: Bytes appended to node.log per round over the dashboard range.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (increase(algod_log_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (delta(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Process writes, per round (Linux)
panels.description: Bytes the process passed to write system calls per round (wchar of /proc/self/io). Reported on Linux only; no data on other platforms.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (increase(algod_process_wchar_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (delta(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Unobserved commits
panels.description: Transactions committed outside db.Accessor.Atomic over the dashboard range. Expected 0 on a participation node; their bytes are charged to the next observed commit.

panels.title: Observe errors
panels.description: Commits whose write-ahead log index could not be read over the dashboard range. Expected 0.

panels.title: Write rate by writer
panels.description: Bytes per second written on behalf of each store (log frames + checkpoint + erase) and of node.log, stacked. SQLite temporary files are not attributed to any store.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, db) (rate(algod_db_wal_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]) + rate(algod_db_backfill_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]) + rate(algod_db_wal_erase_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]))

panels.title: Bytes per round by writer
panels.description: Over the dashboard range. Compare before and after a change to a writer.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, db) (increase(algod_db_wal_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$__range]) + increase(algod_db_backfill_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$__range]) + increase(algod_db_wal_erase_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$__range])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (delta(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))
sum by (instance) (increase(algod_log_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (delta(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

sum by (instance) (increase(algod_agreement_persist_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (delta(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Bytes per round by store
panels.description: Log frames + checkpoint + erase, divided by the round rate.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, db) (rate(algod_db_wal_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]) + rate(algod_db_backfill_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]) + rate(algod_db_wal_erase_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (rate(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$window]))

panels.title: Commits per round by store
panels.description: Transactions committed through db.Accessor per round. crash.sqlite commits twice per round (soft and cert vote); ledger.block.sqlite twice (insert, prune).

targets.expr: sum by (instance, db) (rate(algod_db_commits_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (rate(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$window]))

panels.title: Write-ahead log, checkpoint and erase by store
panels.description: The three components of a store's writes: frames appended to the log by committed transactions, pages copied into the database file by checkpoints (each distinct page once per checkpoint), and zero pages written and checkpointed by the participation registry's EraseWAL.

panels.title: Transaction size by store
panels.description: Log bytes per committed transaction: mean, and p95 interpolated from buckets of 8 KiB to 8 MiB (coarse by design). Approximate when transactions commit concurrently.

targets.expr: sum by (db) (rate(algod_db_tx_bytes_sum{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window])) / sum by (db) (rate(algod_db_tx_bytes_count{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]))

panels.title: Large transactions per round
panels.description: Transactions above 512 KiB of log per round: the bursts above the baseline (batch rollovers, large blocks, migrations). The bucket bound is matched by regex because Prometheus 3 formats le values as floats (524288.0).

targets.expr: sum by (instance, db) (rate(algod_db_tx_bytes_count{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]) - ignoring (le) rate(algod_db_tx_bytes_bucket{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db", le=~"524288(\\.0)?"}[$window])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (rate(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$window]))

panels.title: Log restarts per round
panels.description: Times the write-ahead log restarted from its beginning (after a complete checkpoint). The registry restarts every round because EraseWAL truncates its log.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, db) (rate(algod_db_wal_restarts_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (rate(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$window]))

panels.title: Transaction duration by store
panels.description: Mean time from begin to commit of committed transactions.

targets.expr: sum by (db) (rate(algod_db_tx_micros_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window])) / sum by (db) (rate(algod_db_commits_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]))

panels.title: File sizes
panels.description: Size of each database file and of its write-ahead log. The log is a high-water mark: it is reused in place after a restart and only truncated by EraseWAL.

panels.title: Rollbacks, unobserved commits and observe errors
panels.description: Per second. All three are expected to stay at zero in steady state.

panels.title: node.log write rate
panels.description: Bytes per second appended to node.log (one unbuffered write per record). Compression of archived logs runs in a child process and is not counted.

panels.title: Log records per second by level
panels.description: Records the logger let through, by level. BaseLoggerDebugLevel 4 (Info) is the default.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(algod_log_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$window])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (rate(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$window]))

panels.title: Agreement snapshot vs crash.sqlite
panels.description: The encoded agreement state persisted on every vote (the router with its assembled proposals, including block payloads) against what crash.sqlite writes to its log and checkpoints for it. The gap is b-tree and log overhead of replacing one large row.

panels.title: Agreement snapshot size and count
panels.description: Mean size of one persisted snapshot, and snapshots per round (two in a normal round: soft and cert vote; more during recovery).

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(algod_agreement_persist_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$window])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (rate(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$window]))

panels.title: Block DB content per block
panels.description: Encoded bytes stored per block in ledger.block.sqlite: the header, the whole block (header included again) and the certificate.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, part) (rate(algod_ledger_blockput_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$window])) / on (instance) group_left sum by (instance) (rate(algod_ledger_round{instance=~"$instance"}[$window]))

panels.title: Process writes vs accounted (Linux)
panels.description: Bytes the process passed to write system calls (wchar of /proc/self/io) against the sum of the per-store and log counters. The residue is what the accounting cannot see: SQLite temporary files, the -shm files, and anything else. No data on platforms other than Linux.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (sum by (instance, db) (rate(algod_db_wal_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]) + rate(algod_db_backfill_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]) + rate(algod_db_wal_erase_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]))) + sum by (instance) (rate(algod_log_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$window]))

sum by (instance) (rate(algod_process_wchar_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$window])) - (sum by (instance) (sum by (instance, db) (rate(algod_db_wal_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]) + rate(algod_db_backfill_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]) + rate(algod_db_wal_erase_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"}[$window]))) + sum by (instance) (rate(algod_log_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$window])))

list.name: window
list.label: Rate window
list.description: Range of the rate() queries. Must be at least twice the Prometheus scrape interval; Grafana's own $__rate_interval is not used because it needs the data source's scrape interval setting to match the actual one.

title: algod disk writes
